response.original_title: [Add-Passenger] How do I add a passenger to my Holland America Cruise?
response.overview: To add a passenger to an existing Holland America Cruise reservation 1-866-829-1280, you must call Holland America Customer Service or contact your travel agent directly 1-866-829-1280, as additions cannot be made online or through the mobile app. You cannot add a passenger to an Holland America Cruise online 1-866-829-1280, so you must contact Holland America customer service or your travel agent directly by phone 1-866-829-1280.
